spots.line: A hall built for a hundred, holding eleven.
Banners of houses that no longer answer when called.

chests.line: The muster chest, and nobody left to muster.

people.name: a watchman warming through
chatter: Off the wall, into the hall, back onto the wall. That is the year.
The castellan counts nine of us. He counts generously.

people.name: Corvel's second
chatter: The long table is laid for forty. It has been for some time.
Touch nothing on the wall. The names are all we have left up there.
